newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE cocoa ends up, but off earlier highs.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE cocoa ends up, but off earlier highs.

text.p: LIFFE cocoa futures ended up, after easing back from morning highs and then recovering some of the lost ground in the later stages of trading.
Active March last traded nine stg higher at 896 stg.

The rise this morning was on fund buying, one trader explained. But then the higher prices attracted offers from the Ivory Coast, which pushed prices down, he said. The late recovery was caused by the reappearance of fund and short-covering buyers, he said.
Volume was dominated by March and May. Of a total 8,008 lots traded, 3,196 were on March and 2,624 on May.
